scripts.install:all: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const p1 = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'start'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const p2 = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { p1.kill(); p2.kill(); process.exit(); });"
